Yes. Damevski wants us to pivot away from the three datasets experiment after he learned that the landmarks we got from mediapipe are not FACS landmarks. He wants us to create a new experiment where we record people using vr in some application that makes them experience natural emotions. The example he brought up was ping pong. Say two people are playing ping pong in vr and they both have an avatar that shows their facial expression. We want to record their faces and annotate when they feel certain emotions in the recording. 

He suggested that everyone on the vr team move onto unity. So the other three should be learning about it now. He still wants the emotion recognition demo.

For now, we want to research open source vr games in unity that would be good for such an experiment. Something that would illicit natural emotional expressions when someone is playing it. We want open source because we could open the environment in the editor and add cameras and scripts to record the faces throughout the whole game easily.
